play: (async () => { const w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); if (window.COACH) COACH.closeOffer(); App.settings.speed = 'fast'; App.setTab('play'); App.startGame(''); for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) { if (document.querySelector('#v-play [data-act="pl-bid"]')) break; await w(100); } window.__seq = App.play.state.seq; document.querySelector('#v-play [data-act="pl-bid"][data-b="1"]').click(); })()
played: (() => { const s = App.play.state; return !!s && s.phase === 'play' && s.seq > window.__seq; })()
debug: JSON.stringify((() => { const s = App.play.state; return s ? { phase: s.phase, seq: s.seq, before: window.__seq, turn: s.turn, trick: s.trick.length } : null; })())
